rows.name:
We've relocated the High Entia and[XENO:n ]
Nopon refugees to Colony 6.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Thankfully the Mechon did us a favour by[XENO:n ]
fortifying it for us. It should hold out for a while.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]It's ironic.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

We want to escape Zanza but we[XENO:n ]
can't leave his body, the Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Well...this is our home.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Princess, I have to know. Should we be[XENO:n ]
worried about the evacuated High Entia?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I cannot be sure, but I believe not.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]All those who survived are part Homs like me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Understood.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
If they ever do transform, I will be among them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If that time comes, you know what to do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Are you sure?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Everyone is obliged to accept their fate.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]No way![XENO:wait wait=key ]

There's no way Kallian would leave the fate of the[XENO:n ]
High Entia to you if that was gonna happen![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Precisely.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And Melia... If we are to survive, we must[XENO:n ]
fight Zanza and the Telethia.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It may not be the case with all of them,[XENO:n ]
but a large number of Telethia were once[XENO:n ]
High Entia - your subjects and your brethren.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I am prepared for that.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Even if it means harming my brethren,[XENO:n ]
it is for the protection of the survivors.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
That is the final wish of my father and brother.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I will fight! To free the souls stolen by Zanza.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You are a fighter, Melia. We will need[XENO:n ]
all your strength in the fight ahead.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]How's Shulk?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He's going to make it.[XENO:n ]
His wound has closed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I think Meyneth used the last of[XENO:n ]
her power to protect him...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]So he's OK.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Linada is tending to him now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Fiorung?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
He won't wake up.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It's like his consciousness has sunk[XENO:n ]
to the bottom of a cold, dark lake.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I keep saying his name but he doesn't respond.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Zanza's gonna pay for this![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What if the Telethia attack?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Then we'll have to fight without Shulk.[XENO:n ]
That's why we've strengthened our defences.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That weapon I made should come in handy as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]We're backed into a corner,[XENO:n ]
but we'll give it all we've got.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Can your resistance truly achieve anything?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
What do you mean by that, Alvis?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Exactly what I said. We were all born of the Giant God, of Zanza.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It is Zanza's will that the Telethia return[XENO:n ]
us to the body from whence we came.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

Whether we die of old age or in battle,[XENO:n ]
we all eventually return to the Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]We cannot escape this fate. Am I wrong?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You've got it backwards, man.[XENO:n ]
Just 'cos he thinks it, doesn't make it so.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
We decide whether to keep living or not.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I agree.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Even though he is our creator, that does not[XENO:n ]
afford him the right to take our lives on a whim.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But that is the thinking of a Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
He is a god. Such morals cannot apply to gods.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So you think we should just shut up and die?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
If that is the fate decided by a god.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]You are mistaken if you think we will simply[XENO:n ]
accept such a fate and wait to die.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]We'll never stop fighting.[XENO:n ]
Not till the end![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]To Zanza, the outcome is the same.[XENO:n ]
Thus your logic is flawed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]It ain't the outcome that's important.[XENO:n ]
It's the will to fight back.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Even if you die in vain?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Alvis! Whose side are you on?![XENO:wait wait=key ]

You scared or something?![XENO:n ]
Frightened of a few Telethia?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Stop this. There's no point fighting[XENO:n ]
amongst ourselves![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Fiorung?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Sorry. I need to go and get some air.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
